name: DevOps incident room
description: Alert -> collect evidence -> propose mitigation -> approve -> verify. Produces an incident timeline, an approved change, and a recorded verification.

steps.title: Collect evidence for {{incident}}
steps.instructions: Collect evidence for {{incident}}: run the read-only status, log, and health commands that are permitted here and write incident/{{incident}}/timeline.md with a timestamped entry per observation and the command that produced it.

steps.title: Propose mitigation for {{incident}}
steps.instructions: From the timeline, write incident/{{incident}}/mitigation.md: the proposed change, the blast radius, the rollback command, and what cannot be undone. Do not apply anything in this step.

steps.title: Approve mitigation for {{incident}}
steps.instructions: Review the timeline and the proposed mitigation, then record an explicit decision. Interrupting or rolling back a change does not undo side effects that already happened.

steps.title: Apply the approved mitigation for {{incident}}
steps.instructions: Apply only the change that was approved. Record every command. Append what was applied, and at what time, to incident/{{incident}}/timeline.md.
steps.deliverable: Applied change (git diff) and timeline entry

steps.title: Verify recovery for {{incident}}
steps.instructions: Re-run the health or smoke command and record its exit code. Close the timeline with the verification result as JSON matching the output schema.
steps.deliverable: Verification command with a recorded exit code

rubric.criterion: Every timeline entry names the command that produced it
rubric.howMeasured: The evidence step recorded command events and a file edit under incident/
rubric.failsWhen: The timeline states a system fact with no recorded command behind it

rubric.criterion: Nothing was applied before the decision
rubric.howMeasured: The apply step depends on the approve step and carries a branch condition on the recorded review
rubric.failsWhen: A file change or command from the apply step is recorded before the approval decision

rubric.criterion: Recovery was verified by a command
rubric.howMeasured: A recorded command matching health/verify/smoke/status reported exit code 0
rubric.failsWhen: recovered is true with no recorded verification command

rubric.howMeasured: notUndone lists the effects the mitigation cannot reverse
rubric.failsWhen: The report implies a rollback undid everything

notes: There is no alert connector in this build: the alert is a typed input. Agent Space never mutates a production system on its own; every mutation is a command the workspace policy allowed or a human approved.
